# Realinsight Agent Toolkit

> Public installation and usage guidance for connecting agent harnesses to Realinsight through MCP.

Default: remote Streamable HTTP MCP, production environment.
Optional developer path: local Node stdio MCP from a clone.
Unavailable: native npm/npx installation until the toolkit package is published.

## Primary resources

- Interactive install guide: ./
- Agent-readable install guide: ./agent-install.md
- Machine-readable install catalog: ./install-data.json
- Environment reference: ./environments.md
- Authentication reference: ./auth.md
- Security reference: ./security.md

## Repository resources

- Public repository: https://github.com/cwfs-insight/realinsight-agent-toolkit
- Toolkit skill: https://github.com/cwfs-insight/realinsight-agent-toolkit/blob/main/skills/realinsight-agent-toolkit/SKILL.md
- MCP examples: https://github.com/cwfs-insight/realinsight-agent-toolkit/tree/main/examples/mcp
- Provider distributions: https://github.com/cwfs-insight/realinsight-agent-toolkit/tree/main/providers
